purpose: Admit a deterministic, row-traceable common target across three independently anchored, legally redistributable public sources before any new model fitting.

target_definition.selection_rule: The frozen target set is the exact intersection of canonical accessions having rank_target_eligible=true and a finite strictly positive author value in every one of the three declared source maps.
target_definition.blank_zero_na_policy: Retain source blank, explicit zero and NA states; exclude them from rank eligibility; do not impute or infer non-detection.
target_definition.technical_replicate_policy: Retain every source coordinate and technical replicate in the ledger; do not count technical replicates as independent biological units.
target_definition.biological_independence_policy: Laboratory anchors are counted as distinct source lineages; donor-level independence is reported per source and is not inferred from the laboratory count.

claim_boundary: This protocol admits only a redistributable, row-traceable development common-target asset. It does not establish biological validation, independent lockbox evaluation, no-author reproduction, external adoption, DOI archival or scientific submission readiness.
